title: San Francisco granted seismic tax exclusions with required evidence missing

beats.text: A seismic retrofit can include other improvements in the same building.
The owner had 30 days after completion to notify the assessor.
Supporting documents were due within six months.
State reviewers found that several exclusions lacked required evidence.

visual.line: State reviewers found that several exclusions lacked required evidence

beats.text: The state identified the claim form as BOE-64.
The survey did not identify the buildings or measure lost revenue.

visual.line: The survey did not identify the buildings or measure lost revenue

beats.text: The Assessor described a gap between two offices.

visual.line: The Assessor described a gap between two offices

beats.text: Building inspectors did not routinely report the qualifying costs.

visual.line: Building inspectors did not routinely report the qualifying costs

beats.text: The office said it also checked the cost against independent manuals.
The claim and cost records would show which components staff checked.

visual.line: The claim and cost records would show which components staff checked

beats.text: The record gives no value for work that should have been assessed.

visual.line: The record gives no value for work that should have been assessed

beats.text: Assessment staff said they checked costs and would improve tracking.
